_note: Escalation directory shown when the assistant cannot answer. Verify every entry against nitrkl.ac.in before going live.

academics.how: Raise a request through NITRIS, or write to the Academic Office from your institute webmail via your Faculty Advisor.

exams.how: Speak to your Faculty Advisor first; they can escalate to the Academic Section.

fees.how: Check the latest fee notice on the institute website, then contact Accounts.

hostel.how: Contact your hall warden or hall office.

placements.how: Check CDC notices or write to the CDC.

scholarships.how: Check scholarship notices on the institute website.

general.how: Your Faculty Advisor can route you to the right office.
